page.layout: One printed page of running text in one column; running head at top; page number at top right; no marginal notes of text; faint marks at bottom right are show-through or stains.

main_text.p: fententiarum fingulos pene verborum apices trudentium momento, confilio- rum abditorum profunda rimatione, authoritatem Græcæ nationi fœnera- tur. Suavior elocutione, nervis rerum infirmior, XENOPHON; eique in- hiftoria Græca fuccentunatus, inex- peditione Cyri, & Græcorum è Perfia reditu, infirmam Perfici regni potenti- am, & lateris jam enervati nuditatem, popularibus detexit. In cæteris qui- dem fcriptionum generibus, veritatis tenacior: in expresso ad virtutis imagi- nem Cyro, politicæ difciplinæ confuli- tior. POLYBIUM præter Graii in- genii fagacitatem, ufus Romani contra Pœnos belli, & maximi ducum Ro- manæ militiæ Scipionis familiaritas ex- acuit. DIONYSIUM Halicarnasseum, ad momenta antiquitatis Romanæ te- nebris eruenda, DIODORUM Siculi ad temporum & nationum cum Ro- mano imperio complexionem; AP- PIA.

page.notes: Text is partly obscured by show-through and ink bleed; several words are uncertain, notably "fententiarum", "Halicarnasseum", "Siculi", "infirmam", "imagi-nem", and the line "PIA." which may be a fragment of "APPIA". Lines beginning "Pœnos" and "ducum" are read with doubt. Faint marks at the foot are stains, not text.
